translations.idiomatic: When San Gui rebelled many wanted those ministers killed; Kangxi firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 朕仰紹祖訓，傅恆此事，可援以相比。

translations.literal: I follow my ancestor's teaching; Fu Heng's case may be compared to this."
translations.idiomatic: I follow that teaching; Fu Heng's case is like it."

sentences.zh: 傅恆收猛拱，當賜三眼孔雀翎，疏辭，俟功成拜賜。

translations.literal: Fu Heng had recovered Menggong and should have been given triple-eyed peacock feathers; he memorialized to decline, asking to receive them only after success.
translations.idiomatic: For recovering Menggong he should have received triple-eyed peacock feathers; he declined until victory.

sentences.zh: 今既未克賊巢，當繳進賜翎，以稱其請罪之意。

translations.literal: Now that the enemy nest has not been taken, he should return the bestowed feathers to match his plea for guilt."
translations.idiomatic: Since the nest was not taken he should return the feathers in keeping with his plea for guilt."

sentences.zh: 」懵駁遣頭人詣軍獻方物。

translations.literal: Meng Bo sent headmen to the army to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Bo sent headmen with gifts to the army.

sentences.zh: 十月，傅恆還駐虎踞關，上命傅恆會雲貴總督彰寶議減雲南總兵、知府員缺，釐正州縣舊制。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Fu Heng returned to garrison at Hujuguan; the emperor ordered Fu Heng to meet with Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Zhang Bao to discuss reducing the posts of Yunnan regional commander and prefect, and to rectify the old prefectural and county system.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Fu Heng returned to Hujuguan; the emperor had him meet Governor-General Zhang Bao to trim Yunnan military and civil posts and restore county administration.

sentences.zh: 三十四年二月，班師。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-fourth year the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-fourth year the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三月，上幸天津，傅恆朝行在。

translations.literal: In the third month the emperor visited Tianjin and Fu Heng attended at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the emperor went to Tianjin and Fu Heng attended at the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 既而緬甸酋謝罪表久不至，上謂傅恆方病，不忍治其罪。

translations.literal: Later the Burmese chief's letter of apology long failed to arrive; the emperor said Fu Heng was ill and could not bear to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: When Burma's apology long failed to come, the emperor said Fu Heng was too ill to punish.

sentences.zh: 七月，卒，上親臨其第酹酒，命喪葬視宗室鎮國公，諡文忠。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he died; the emperor personally visited his residence to pour a libation, ordered funeral rites equal to a imperial clan prince of the third rank, and gave the posthumous title Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he died; the emperor poured a libation at his house, gave him funeral honors equal to a third-rank imperial prince, and posthumous title Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 又命入祀前所建宗祠。

translations.literal: He was also ordered entered in sacrifice at the ancestral hall built earlier.
translations.idiomatic: He was also enshrined in the hall built for him earlier.

sentences.zh: 其後上复幸天津，念傅恆於此復命，又經傅恆墓賜奠，皆紀以詩。

translations.literal: Later when the emperor again visited Tianjin, remembering Fu Heng's report there, and passing Fu Heng's tomb to bestow offerings, he recorded each in verse.
translations.idiomatic: On later visits to Tianjin he remembered Fu Heng's report there and marked his tomb with verse.

sentences.zh: 及賦懷舊詩，許為「社稷臣」。

translations.literal: In a poem recalling old ministers he called him a "pillar of the state."
translations.idiomatic: In a poem of remembrance he called him a pillar of the state.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，以福康安平苗功，贈貝子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, because Fukang'an pacified the Miao, he was posthumously given the rank of beile.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1, for Fukang'an's pacification of the Miao, he was posthumously made beile.

sentences.zh: 福康安卒，推恩贈郡王銜，旋並命配享太廟。

translations.literal: When Fukang'an died, favor was extended to grant a prince's title; soon he was also ordered to share sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: When Fukang'an died he was given a prince's title and soon also enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 傅恆直軍機處二十三年，日侍左右，以勤慎得上眷。

translations.literal: Fu Heng served in the Grand Council for twenty-three years, daily attending at the emperor's side, and through diligence and prudence won deep favor.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng served twenty-three years in the Grand Council at the emperor's side and won deep favor through diligence.

sentences.zh: 故事，軍機處諸臣不同入見，乾隆初，惟訥親承旨。

translations.literal: By precedent Grand Council ministers did not enter audience together; in early Qianlong only Ne Qin received edicts.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent council ministers did not audience together; early in Qianlong only Ne Qin took edicts.

sentences.zh: 迨傅恆自陳不能多識，乞諸大臣同入見。

translations.literal: When Fu Heng said he could not remember much and begged that all ministers enter together, this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng said he could not remember enough and asked that all ministers audience together, which was granted.

sentences.zh: 上晚膳後有所諮訪，又召傅恆獨對，時謂之「晚面」。

translations.literal: After the emperor's evening meal, when he wished to consult on something, he again summoned Fu Heng for a private audience, called at the time the "evening audience."
translations.idiomatic: After supper when he wished to consult he summoned Fu Heng alone—the "evening audience."

sentences.zh: 又軍機處諸大臣既承旨，退自屬草，至傅恆始命章京具稿以進。

translations.literal: Also, after Grand Council ministers received an edict they withdrew to draft themselves; only from Fu Heng's time were clerks ordered to prepare drafts for submission.
translations.idiomatic: After receiving edicts ministers had drafted themselves; under Fu Heng clerks prepared drafts.

sentences.zh: 上倚傅恆為重臣，然偶有小節疏失，即加以戒約。

translations.literal: The emperor relied on Fu Heng as a weighty minister, yet if he had even a small lapse he was at once admonished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor relied on him heavily, yet admonished the smallest lapse.

sentences.zh: 傅恆益謙下，治事不敢自擅。

translations.literal: Fu Heng became all the more humble and in handling affairs did not dare act on his own authority.
translations.idiomatic: He grew more humble and would not act on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 敬禮士大夫，翼後進使盡其才。

translations.literal: He respected scholar-officials and helped juniors bring their talents to full use.
translations.idiomatic: He respected scholars and helped juniors use their talents.

sentences.zh: 行軍與士卒同甘苦。

translations.literal: On campaign he shared hardship with the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign he shared the soldiers' hardships.

sentences.zh: 卒時未五十，上尤惜之。

translations.literal: He died not yet fifty, and the emperor grieved for him especially.
translations.idiomatic: He died before fifty, which the emperor especially mourned.

sentences.zh: 子福靈安、福隆安、福康安、福長安。

translations.literal: His sons were Fu Ling'an, Fu Long'an, Fukang'an, and Fu Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Fu Ling'an, Fu Long'an, Fukang'an, and Fu Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 福康安自有傳。

translations.literal: Fukang'an has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 福靈安，多羅額駙，授侍衛。

translations.literal: Fu Ling'an, a prince consort of the first degree, was appointed guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ling'an, a first-rank prince consort, became a guard.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾之役，從將軍兆惠戰於葉爾羌，有功，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the Dzungar campaign he followed General Zhaohui and fought at Yarkand with merit, and was given a hereditary yunqiwei rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dzungar war he followed General Zhaohui at Yarkand with merit and received a hereditary yunqiwei rank.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，授正白旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was appointed vice commander of the Manchu Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he became vice commander of the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 署雲南永北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He acted as regional commander of Yongbei garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting regional commander at Yongbei in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 福隆安，尚高宗女和嘉公主，授和碩額駙、御前侍衛。

translations.literal: Fu Long'an married the Qianlong Emperor's daughter Princess Hejia and was appointed prince consort of the second degree and guard before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Long'an married Princess Hejia and became second-rank prince consort and imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，擢兵部尚書、軍機處行走，移工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was promoted to minister of war and served in the Grand Council, then transferred to minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he became minister of war and joined the Grand Council, then minister of works.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，襲一等忠勇公。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he inherited the first-class Loyal and Brave Dukedom.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year he inherited the first-class Loyal and Brave Dukedom.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，用兵金川，總兵宋元俊劾四川總督桂林，命福隆安往讞。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, when troops were used in Jinchuan, regional commander Song Yuanjun impeached Sichuan governor-general Guilin, and Fu Long'an was ordered to go try the case.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, during the Jinchuan campaign, Song Yuanjun impeached Governor-General Guilin and Fu Long'an was sent to try the case.

sentences.zh: 福隆安直桂林，抵元俊罪。

translations.literal: Fu Long'an supported Guilin and convicted Yuanjun.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Long'an upheld Guilin and convicted Yuanjun.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，复授兵部尚書，仍領工部。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year he was again made minister of war while retaining works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year he was again minister of war while keeping works.

sentences.zh: 金川平，畫像紫光閣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified his portrait was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinchuan was pacified his portrait joined the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，卒，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he died; posthumous title Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year he died with posthumous title Qinke.

sentences.zh: 子丰紳濟倫，初以公主子，命視和碩額駙品秩，授鑲藍旗漢軍副都統、奉宸苑卿。

translations.literal: His son Feng Shenjilun, at first as the princess's son was ordered treated with the rank of a prince consort of the second degree, and was appointed vice commander of the Han Bordered Blue Banner and director of the Imperial Parks.
translations.idiomatic: His son Feng Shenjilun, as the princess's son, was given second-rank consort privileges and made vice commander of the Han Bordered Blue Banner and director of the Imperial Parks.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，襲爵。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year he inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 累遷兵部尚書，領鑾儀衛。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to minister of war and directed the imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to minister of war and directed the imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，再坐事，官終盛京兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing period he was twice punished for offenses and ended as vice minister of war at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing he was twice punished and ended as Mukden vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he died.

sentences.zh: 子富勒渾翁珠，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Fulehunwengzhu inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fulehunwengzhu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 福長安，自藍翎侍衛累遷至正紅旗滿洲副都統、武備院卿，領內務府。

translations.literal: Fu Chang'an rose from blue-lance guard to vice commander of the Manchu Plain Red Banner, director of the Armory, and head of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Chang'an rose from blue-lance guard to Plain Red Banner vice commander, Armory director, and Imperial Household head.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十五年，命在軍機處學習行走。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year of Qianlong he was ordered to study and serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 45 he was assigned to study in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，台灣平。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year Taiwan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year Taiwan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，廓爾喀平。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year Gurkha was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year Gurkha was pacified.

sentences.zh: 諸功臣畫像紫光閣，福長安皆與焉。

translations.literal: When meritorious ministers' portraits were painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor, Fu Chang'an was among them.
translations.idiomatic: He was among the portraits in the Hall of Purple Splendor for both campaigns.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，俘王三槐，福長安以直軍機處得侯。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, when Wang Sanhuai was captured, Fu Chang'an received a marquisate for serving in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3, when Wang Sanhuai was taken, he received a marquisate for Grand Council service.

sentences.zh: 四年，高宗崩，大學士和珅得罪，仁宗以福長安阿附，逮下獄，奪爵，籍其家。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Qianlong Emperor died; Grand Secretary Heshen was condemned; the Jiaqing Emperor, because Fu Chang'an had fawned on him, had him arrested, stripped of rank, and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Qianlong died and Heshen fell; Jiaqing arrested Fu Chang'an for fawning on Heshen, stripped his rank, and confiscated his estate.

sentences.zh: 諸大臣議用朋黨律坐立斬，上命改監候，而賜和珅死，使監福長安詣和珅死所跪視。

translations.literal: The ministers proposed conviction under the faction statute with immediate execution; the emperor ordered imprisonment awaiting execution instead, and when Heshen was ordered to die had Fu Chang'an escorted to kneel where Heshen died.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers proposed the faction law and death; the emperor commuted to imprisonment and made him kneel where Heshen was executed.

sentences.zh: 旋遣往裕陵充供茶拜唐阿，就遷員外郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent to serve tea at the Yuling mausoleum as a bannerman and was then made a department director.
translations.idiomatic: He was then sent to serve at Yuling mausoleum and made a department director.

sentences.zh: 六年，以請還京，奪職，發盛京披甲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, for asking to return to the capital, he was stripped of office and sent to Mukden as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he asked to return to the capital, lost his post, and was sent to Mukden as a soldier.

sentences.zh: 旋自驍騎校屢遷：再為圍場總管，一為馬蘭鎮總兵，再署古北口提督。

translations.literal: Soon from bold cavalry commandant he was repeatedly promoted: twice park superintendent, once regional commander of Malan, twice acting commander at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: He was later promoted from cavalry commandant to park superintendent, Malan regional commander, and twice acting Gubeikou commander.

sentences.zh: 屢坐事譴謫。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly punished and demoted for offenses.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly punished and demoted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授正黃旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed vice commander of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he became Plain Yellow Banner vice commander.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：高宗初政，寬大而清明，舉國熙熙，樂見太平。

translations.literal: The commentator says: In the Qianlong Emperor's early rule the government was lenient yet clear, and the whole realm rejoiced to see peace.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Early in Qianlong's reign the government was lenient and clear, and the realm rejoiced in peace.

sentences.zh: 是時鄂爾泰、張廷玉負夾輔之重，然居中用事為天子喉舌，厥惟訥親，繼之者傅恆也。

translations.literal: At that time Ortai and Zhang Tingyu bore the weight of assisting rule, yet those who handled affairs at the center as the Son of Heaven's voice were Ne Qin, and after him Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai and Zhang Tingyu bore the weight of assisting rule, but the emperor's voice at court was Ne Qin, then Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 高宗手詔謂當鄂爾泰在朝，培養陶成，得一訥親；

translations.literal: The emperor wrote by his own hand that while Ortai was in court he nurtured and shaped talent until he had one Ne Qin;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote that while Ortai was in court he nurtured talent until he had Ne Qin;

sentences.zh: 訥親在朝，培養陶成，得一傅恆。

translations.literal: while Ne Qin was in court he nurtured and shaped talent until he had one Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: while Ne Qin was in court he nurtured talent until he had Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 又謂訥親受恩第一，次則傅恆。

translations.literal: He also said Ne Qin received favor first, and next Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: He also said Ne Qin received favor first, then Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 訥親視師失上指，坐誅，終不沒其勤廉；

translations.literal: Ne Qin lost the emperor's intent in commanding the army and was executed, yet in the end his diligence and integrity were not erased;
translations.idiomatic: Ne Qin lost the emperor's favor in command and was executed, yet his diligence and integrity were not erased;

sentences.zh: 傅恆再以受降還師，德心孚契，自以其謹慎，非徒藉貴戚功閥重也。

translations.literal: Fu Heng again accepted surrender and withdrew the army; the emperor's heart was in true accord with him, and this was because of his prudence, not merely because he was a noble kinsman of meritorious stock.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng accepted surrender and withdrew, and the emperor's heart was truly with him—not merely because he was a noble kinsman of an old military house.
